name: gallery-tunnel
title: Gallery Tunnel
description: A flight down a rectangular corridor whose walls, floor and ceiling hold coloured slabs between thin edge mouldings, fading into fog: a continuous, loopable forward-motion backdrop. WebGL.
useWhen: A forward-motion backdrop: a lit corridor of coloured panels for an intro, a gallery or a product reel.
A loopable travel shot that needs no footage: speed, palette and density are variables.
avoidWhen: The scene needs photos in the panels: this block only has colour slabs.
The viewer is prone to motion discomfort: the flight is constant.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Slab palette
variables.description: Comma-separated hex colours for the coloured slabs.

variables.label: Grid density
variables.description: Slots per wall face per axis (2 gives 16 per segment).

variables.label: Fog distance
variables.description: Depth, in segments, at which the corridor reaches the pure backdrop colour.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the corridor is drawn at, then scaled up. Thin edge lines need 0.75.
